name: Lighthouse Keeper
source:
This dark act takes place from a single day of the Lighthouse Keeper. Listen to keeper carefully and help him to interrupt his twenty-years-old shift at the Lighthouse.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这一黑暗行为发生在灯塔守护者的一天之内。仔细听看门人的话，帮助他打断灯塔二十年的轮班。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469370/]Steam[/url]]
